user_saw: A ChatGPT subscription model could appear in the picker and then be rejected when used on a prerelease or development build.
summary: OpenClaw now sends the same numeric release or 99.0.0 fallback for ChatGPT model listing and Responses turns while preserving the full build version in User-Agent.
reasoning: I checked the attribution code before #202380 and confirmed that Responses already sent the raw runtime version. An earlier listing change already warned that development placeholders could get HTTP 400, and #202380 exposed the mismatch in the current listing path by normalizing the version only for discovery. The fix reports a live rejection for an older numeric version, while the prerelease and development cases were verified at the header level.
